questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 5$ in trigonometry in 3d (extended), evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0$.
A data set recorded for trigonometry in 3d (extended) consists of the four values $\{11, 15, 19, 25\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $11 + 15 + 19 + 25 = 70$, and dividing by $4$ gives $17.5$.
